title: 72. How do I adjust the default escape message?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I adjust the default escape message.
short_answer: The escape page contains the message that your participants see if your survey is not available. To change the default message, open the survey, go to the 'Properties' page. You will find the 'Unavailability Page' option under 'Special Pages'. If you have already published your survey, please remember to go to the 'Overview' page and click on 'Apply Changes'.
